title: Wikipedia: Project management
summary: Surveys project management process groups, including monitoring and controlling, integrated change control, and lessons-learned meetings held to consolidate learnings. Motivates PM01, PM03, PM04, and PM08 as readings of status, change, blocker, and retrospective text. It is motivation for the patterns, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Risk register
summary: Describes a risk register as a record of identified risks with additional information such as the risk owner and mitigation measures, and defines a trigger as the event that results in the risk occurring. Motivates PM02's owner, trigger, and mitigation check and PM04's reading of what a blocker waits on. Motivation only, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Change control
summary: Describes change control as a process of plan and scope, assess, review and approval, build, implement, and close steps so that changes are introduced in a controlled way. Motivates PM03's separation of scope changes from clarifications and PM07's reading of approval replies. Motivation only, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Minutes
summary: States that the primary function of minutes is to record the decisions made, and that a summary of the discussions is distinct from the decisions themselves. Motivates PM05's decision-versus-discussion reading and PM06 and PM07 as readings of what recorded items and replies state. Motivation only, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Action item
summary: Describes an action item as a documented task that can be handled by a single person, typically assigned to someone who is then obligated to perform it and report back, and usually recorded in meeting minutes. Motivates PM06's owner and due expression check. Motivation only, not evidence of Jev performance.
